subject: Proposed pivoted reporting + merit-transition plan for model-serving org
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lila Saito <lila.s@talentbridge.com>, TalentBridge HR <hr-peopleops@talentbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed pivoted reporting + merit-transition plan for model-serving org

Team —

After the last leadership check-in and feedback from Eng/Product, I put together a focused proposal to consolidate two senior manager roles in Model Serving into a single senior engineering manager and to realign the periphery ownership (runtime infra, batching, and observability) under that manager. The goal is to simplify handoffs, reduce cross-manager dependencies, and preserve a clear career path into senior IC/manager levels ahead of the July performance cycle.

High-level:
- Merge Manager A and Manager B into one consolidated role (new title: Senior Manager, Model Serving).
- Reassign ~5 ICs across two pods (matrix in attached role_scope_matrix.xlsx).
- Implement a 90-day merit-transition safety window: no involuntary performance actions tied to the reorg while new reporting lines settle.
- Communication plan draft attached (comm_draft_v1.docx) and a public comm doc link below.

Requested next steps:
1) Review the role_scope_matrix and highlight operational gaps by EOD Tue.
2) Confirm exceptions (customer-facing on-call, ongoing projects) we need to keep intact.
3) If we agree, I’ll push a final comm and schedule 1:1s with impacted folks next week.

Why now: this reduces context switching during the new model rollout and gives us a clearer path for merit budgeting. I’m including TalentBridge for a quick sanity check on messaging and the legal/HR implications.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: role_scope_matrix.xlsx, comm_draft_v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lila Saito <lila.s@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed pivoted reporting + merit-transition plan for model-serving org

Thanks Naomi — good, crisp framing. A few inline notes from my side: 

> Merge Manager A and Manager B into one consolidated role
- I support consolidation but would like an explicit exception for the customer-facing on-call lead (they rotate across pods and should remain independent of the new manager for 6 months).

> Reassign ~5 ICs across two pods
- Please mark Diego Fernandez and Mina Haddad as "do not move until product sign-off" — both are mid-project and a mid-reorg switch would be risky.

> 90-day merit-transition safety window
- Strong +1. We should also call out that the merit cycle (July) will be handled under old managers for fairness, with a retro-fit calibration if needed.

I added comments in the comm draft where I think the tone needs to be slightly more reassuring for ICs (emphasize no immediate role changes and available mobility discussions).

Marissa
Senior Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed pivoted reporting + merit-transition plan for model-serving org

Agree with the direction and appreciate the safety window. A couple of operational asks: 

- Can we schedule the 1:1s next Wed/Thu so managers have time to prep? I can take the first batch (AM).
- Diego and Mina: noted — they stay on current managers until product completes phase 2 (target: 6/15).
- Suggest we create a temporary escalation path for any performance concerns during the 90-day window: make staff engineer leads the first checkpoint before any HR escalation.

I uploaded a quick timeline (internal) to the shared doc — link in the attachment list. Also recommend we loop Ben for any customer-impacted resource constraints; his call on capacity matters.

Jonas
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — consolidating final items below and next steps.

Final decisions:
- Consolidation approved: Manager A + Manager B -> Senior Manager, Model Serving (effective 5/17).
- Diego Fernandez and Mina Haddad are exempt from repointing until product phase 2 completes (target 6/15).
- Customer-facing on-call lead remains independent for 6 months; Ben will draft the customer comm if needed.
- 90-day merit-transition safety window confirmed; July merit cycle will be applied under current managers with calibration as required.

Deliverables I’ll share this afternoon:
1) Updated role_scope_matrix.xlsx (final)
2) Final comm_draft_v1.docx with Product Leadership added and the softened messaging.
3) A DocuSign packet for the two manager role changes (link above).

Requested: please review the final doc in the shared drive and reply with approval by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the 5/17 effective date. If no replies, I’ll assume tacit approval and begin scheduling 1:1s on Mon.

Naomi
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
